ci_serving_burst.shape: 100 input / 100 output / 32 requests / unconstrained client concurrency

root_cause: The production full-depth path exposed two real prefill allocations that the reduced two-layer probe did not: get_block_size indexed a TT tensor and materialized a slice, and generic warmup did not compile the explicit per-request per-layer page-table signature used by vLLM PagedFillCache.
fix: Inspect only Python cache containers when reading block size, and run one explicit B1 per-layer page-table prefill warmup before decode trace capture. Tracking remained enabled for program-cache buffers; no skip/exclusion variable was used.
